newsitem.title: USA: SUSA Partnership issues $100 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: SUSA Partnership issues $100 mln in notes.

text.p: The following debt issue from SUSA Partnership (Storage USA) was priced on Thursday, according to lead manager Goldman Sachs & Co.

Storage USA, based in Columbia, Maryland, is a self-managed real estate investment trust that operates primarily in self-storage facilities. Proceeds from the offering will be used for general corporate purposes including repayment of debts, property improvements and acquisitions.
TYPE NOTES ISS PRICE 99.561 FIRST PAY DATE 12/01/97
LAST MOODY'S BAA3 YIELD 8.245 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P BBB-MINUS SPREAD 120 BPS CALLS MAKE-WHOLE @ U.S.
NOTE: Priced over old 30-year Treasury bond
